# Required Images for SEO

To complete the SEO optimization, please add these images:

## 1. Open Graph Image (og-image.jpg)
- **Location**: `/public/og-image.jpg`
- **Dimensions**: 1200 x 630 pixels (Facebook/LinkedIn recommended)
- **Format**: JPG or PNG
- **Content**: Telugu Panchangam USA branding with text "Telugu Panchangam 2026 | New Jersey Eastern Time"
- **File size**: < 1MB

## 2. Logo (logo.png)
- **Location**: `/public/logo.png`
- **Dimensions**: 512 x 512 pixels (square)
- **Format**: PNG with transparency
- **Content**: Telugu Panchangam USA logo
- **File size**: < 100KB

## 3. Favicon (favicon.ico)
- **Location**: `/public/favicon.ico`
- **Dimensions**: 32x32, 16x16 (multi-size ICO)
- **Format**: ICO
- **Content**: Simple Telugu Panchangam icon

## Design Recommendations:
- Use traditional Indian calendar imagery
- Include Telugu script for "పంచాంగం"
- Use colors: Saffron (#FF9933), White (#FFFFFF), Green (#138808)
- Make text readable even at small sizes
- Ensure high contrast for accessibility

## Alternative:
Until custom images are created, you can use placeholder images or generate them using:
- Canva.com (free templates)
- Figma (design from scratch)
- Online OG image generators
